_review: Part a of 40-45 (Eastern Kingdoms). Entry is Grom'gol, Stranglethorn Vale (31.4, 29.9), level 40: the exact exit of 35-40b. Exit is the Grom'gol zeppelin to Orgrimmar (Durotar, verified in travel.json) at level 42; 40-45b must start at Orgrimmar.

Exit level 42 is the honest estimate. Quest XP alone is 149,550, which reaches 41.6 on the validator curve (40 to 41 is 90,700 XP, 40 to 42 is 186,500). Kill XP is not counted, so 42 is the expected in-game level at Orgrimmar.

W_XP_RANGE (80% of the 40 to 42 budget): not padded. Pack quests left out are Kalimdor (Tanaris, Thousand Needles, Dustwallow, Desolace, Feralas, Durotar), profession-gated (Blacksmithing, Engineering), instanced (Uldaman, Scarlet Monastery, Arathi Basin), level 43 to 47 only, reputation or battleground, or have no XP row.
W_NEXT_NOT_LOADED is expected: horde_horde_40-45b is written in the next phase.

W_NOT_IN_PACK for quest 687 (Theldurin the Lost): handed over from 35-40b. It starts with Zaruk in Hammerfall (2787) and turns in to Theldurin in the Badlands; it is needed for 692. The 35-40b drop reason (needs 653 or 688) is now satisfied because 688 is turned in here.

Elite quests are never dropped. 197 and 208 (Nesingwary, lv 43) are routed with revisitAt 44; 197 is hunter-only. 520 (Mug'thol, lv 43, Alterac), 613 (Mosh'Ogg Warmonger, lv 41-45) are optional-elite with revisitAt 44.

Conflict for main-session decision: 591 (Mai'Zoth, Mind's Eye, lv 47) and 8551 (Gorlash, Smotts' Chest, lv 47) are elites 5 levels above the route. Elite quests must not be dropped and the 'no mobs 3+ above' rule conflicts with that. Both are placed last (Grom'gol and Booty Bay at about level 42) with revisitAt 47 and are flagged here; the mob-level validator does not warn on them.
Quest 348 (Stranglethorn Fever, Mokk the Savage lv 44) is placed after level 42 (+2). Its child 349 has no XP row.
Hunter-only quests 196 and 197 carry classes HUNTER (no XP for other classes). 208 is not class-limited in the DB and is kept for everyone.

Trainers: Booty Bay rogue (about 41), Stonard hunter, shaman, warlock, warrior (42), Undercity paladin, priest, warrior and mage, warlock (42). No druid trainer is on this path (Thunder Bluff only), so druid has a gap from 40 to exit.

Hearth binds: Booty Bay (Skindle), Hammerfall (Adegwa), Stonard (Karakul), Tarren Mill (Shay). HEARTH_USE is used for the Mosh'Ogg to Booty Bay, Stromgarde to Hammerfall and Swamp coast to Stonard returns.

Transport not verified in game: Booty Bay to Hammerfall and Hammerfall to Kargath and Stonard (wind riders Urda, Gorrik, Breyk, all discovered). The Tarren Mill and Undercity legs are walks; the Undercity to Grom'gol zeppelin and the Grom'gol to Orgrimmar zeppelin are verified.

Dropped for the next band (Kalimdor, 40-45b): 243 and 4450 (Tanaris), 1108, 1119, 1127, 1137 (Thousand Needles chain from Fizzle and Kravel), 2935 (Sen'jin Village, Durotar), 2861, 2864, 2872 (Tanaris and Dustwallow breadcrumbs), 703 (wings, Tanaris and Desolace), 1261 (Dustwallow pendant), 624 and 625 (Dustwallow scroll), 736 (Dagun in Dustwallow), 4489 (Ratchet), 79358 and 79361 (totems, Dustwallow and Desolace).
Searing Gorge quests 4449 and 4451 need level 43 and sit in Eastern Kingdoms; they are not reached before the 42 exit. Left for the main session to decide whether 40-45b or a later band takes them.

Stale notes in the 35-40b handoff: 1190 to 1194, 1948, 1951, 1952, 1956 to 1958, 1262, 7541, 1372, 1388, 1391, 3631, 4781 to 4786, 1203, 1136, 2862, 2283, 2284, 737, 635 and 6134 are not in this pack. The DB checks show Kalimdor (Thousand Needles, Dustwallow, Desolace, Ratchet), Duskwood, Uldaman or class and profession chains, so none are routed here.

Data gaps: 349, 593 and 1422 have no XP row (child or start steps). 2934 (Undamaged Venom Sac) needs a second Hinterlands trip after the Lydon turn-in and is dropped. 2995 is accepted only from Oran in Undercity, which this route visits after the Hinterlands; dropped.
Quest 4964 (negative preQuestGroup id -4962) is not in this pack; the 35-40b question is still open for the main session.
